passage.text: Booha is in his classroom. His notebook and pencil are on the desk. His bag is under the chair. Nuppi writes on the board. Mimo has a ruler, an eraser, and a pencil case. The teacher gives them scissors and glue for a picture. After class, Booha puts the textbook in his locker and paper in the trash can. Then he turns off the computer.

passage.text: Booha has many classes at school. He reads a story in Japanese and speaks in English. He uses numbers in math and does a test in science. In social studies, he learns about history and geography. After lunch, he runs in PE and sings in music. He draws a picture in art and cooks in home economics. Computer class is fun, but Booha must finish his homework before tomorrow's test.

passage.text: A new student comes to Booha's school. The teacher shows her the classroom. The principal says hello, and the school nurse shows her the health room. A librarian helps her find a book. Her classmate Nuppi asks her to play at break. An older student shows her the office, and a younger student smiles at her. The coach helps everyone practice. At the end of the day, the new student thanks the school staff.

comprehension.q: Who helps the new student find a book?
What does the new student do at the end?

passage.text: Booha looks at his school schedule. In the morning, class starts when the bell rings. He eats lunch at noon and plays outside during break. In the afternoon, he has one more class. School finishes at three. After school, Booha plays with Nuppi, but they watch the clock and go home on time. On Monday, they will start a new schedule.

comprehension.q: What tells Booha that class starts?
Why do Booha and Nuppi watch the clock?
